basis: February 7, 2024 is verified as the actual-results date. Azenta reported fiscal Q1 2024 consolidated GAAP revenue of $154,317,000 versus $178,366,000 for the prior December quarter, a 13.483% decline that clears the $169,447,700 cutoff. Both periods include B Medical Systems. The strongest earlier candidate is November 13. Management forecast a mid-teens consolidated decline, and an analyst translated that into −15% during Q&A. Management's reply confirmed the source of the decline without adopting the analyst's figure as a revenue bound. The January decks and secondary conference transcripts yielded no earlier qualifying figure, but the official conference replays could not be verified. The earliest qualifying date therefore remains open.

coverage.detail: August 8, preceding earnings cycle. The $155–173 million range covered fiscal Q4 2023, ending September 30. The $648–665 million range covered fiscal 2023.

Reopened the issuer decks for UBS on August 15, Baird on September 12 and Morgan Stanley on September 13. Their forecasts refer back to August fiscal 2023 guidance. The $178 million Q1 FY2023 column is historical.
September 26. Azenta expressly reaffirmed the August guidance for fiscal Q4 2023.

November 13, immediately preceding earnings release. The $696–718 million revenue range and 5–8% organic growth forecast cover all of fiscal 2024. The companion exhibit concerns governance and capital allocation.

November 13, slide 16 of the complete issuer deck. Management said “Overall, Q1 expected to decline mid-teens year-over-year.” The approximately 75% decline applied to B Medical alone. The remaining businesses had a combined low-single-digit growth forecast. None supplies an explicit consolidated endpoint.

November 13 call rescue. The issuer's archive at https://investors.azenta.com/2023 lists the release, slides and filing for this call. The secondary transcript identifies Vijay Kumar as the analyst who estimated −15%. The CEO confirmed that B Medical drove the decline. The CFO's follow-up addressed Q1 orders and business mix.

Stephens. Azenta scheduled a November 16 public presentation for 11 a.m. Central and directed investors to https://investors.azenta.com/events for the replay. The host page at https://www.stephens.com/events/stephens-annual-investment-conference linked a one-page agenda. Neither yielded the remarks. The host-platform lookup at https://wsw.com/webcast/stph34/azta/ was inaccessible.

November 16 secondary transcript. Management discussed B Medical orders and the difficult comparison with fiscal Q1 2023. I found no explicit consolidated fiscal Q1 2024 revenue bound in those remarks.

November 29, Evercore. The host agenda designates Azenta for one-to-one meetings only, consistent with the issuer notice at https://investors.azenta.com/2023-11-21-Azenta-to-Participate-in-the-6th-Annual-Evercore-ISI-HealthCONx-Conference.

January 11, J.P. Morgan. The issuer page dates the session to 7:30 a.m. Pacific. Its complete deck at https://investors.azenta.com/download/Azenta-Investor_Overview_for_JPM_1.8.24_5PM.pdf identifies $696–718 million as historical full-year guidance. The linked host replay at https://jpmorgan.metameetings.net/events/healthcare24/sessions/49707-azenta/webcast?gpu_only=true&kiosk=true returned a cache miss. The secondary remarks at https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/azta/transcripts/155999-j-p-morgan-42nd-annual-healthcare-conference-2024/ yielded no consolidated Q1 endpoint.

January 18, Needham. The recovered issuer deck labels $696–718 million as the November full-year range. The host-platform lookup at https://wsw.com/webcast/needham134/azta/ was inaccessible. In the secondary Q&A at https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/azta/transcripts/157231-26th-annual-needham-growth-virtual-conference/, the Q1 breakeven discussion concerned EBITDA.
January 31. The recast segment tables show $178 million of consolidated revenue, including $42 million from B Medical, for the quarter ended December 31, 2022. That is the comparison period.
The intervening issuer archive includes a January 25 earnings-call notice and a February 2 product launch. I found no preliminary consolidated December-quarter revenue release.

February 7 actuals. The consolidated statements of operations, in thousands, show products of 53,393 plus services of 100,924, totaling 154,317 against 178,366. The separately disclosed 15% organic decline uses a different basis.

publication_date_evidence: The November 13 release announced the public call for 4:30 p.m. Eastern that day, and the issuer deck bears the same date. The actual-results exhibit is datelined February 7, 2024. EDGAR records acceptance that day at 16:21:16 at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/933974/000155837024000860/0001558370-24-000860-index.htm. That establishes publication of the actuals before the February 8 Form 10-Q. The unavailable official conference recordings leave precedence unresolved.
